# dOd

> dOd is the big data platform for AI agents. Claude, ChatGPT or your own agents connect once and ask questions in plain English; dOd's embedded map-reduce model builder turns each question into an exact plan and runs it over the data where it lives, even terabytes. Only the short answer goes back to the agent.

- No SQL: questions are compiled into exact plans, with no text-to-SQL translation and no guessed joins. dOd says how it worked out every answer.
- No GPUs: the data is processed by a map-reduce engine on ordinary CPUs.
- No rows sent to an AI: the language model only plans the question; tables never pass through it, so there are no AI token charges on the data.
- Connects to Google Sheets, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, Apache Iceberg, and CSV or Parquet uploads.
- Works with ChatGPT and Claude, and any agent, over MCP.
- Dashboards that stay up to date, team sharing, and charts shared as cards.

## Pricing

Priced in d0d Units (DU): one DU-hour is one worker CPU for one hour, billed per second with no minimum. Idle time, rejected plans and cached answers cost nothing, and there are no per-token AI charges.

- Free: $0, no card. 50 DU-hours a month, one workspace, your own data. Stops at the limit.
- Pro: $99/month. 600 DU-hours included, then $0.08 per DU-hour up to a spending cap. Unlimited users and agents.
- Team: $499/month. 4,000 DU-hours included, then $0.07 per DU-hour. 5 workspaces, saved metrics, audit log, priority support.
- Annual commitment: prepaid DU-hours at 20% off ($0.064), or reserved always-on workers at $0.05 per DU-hour.
- Enterprise, in your own cloud: from $30K/year, $40 per worker CPU per month, minimum 64 CPUs.
